title: Delimiting Extension for a Period of Total Disability on Education Benefits
content:
**Adjudication note — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) and the student's own Disability Compensation award.**

**Basis.** The delimiting extension for a period of total disability is worked out from the student's compensation award. The delimiting cut-off is the thirtieth day of the month, or, when the benefit carries a delimiting date, the earlier of the thirtieth day and the day of the month on which the delimiting date falls once it has been moved later by the delimiting extension, counting the first day of the month as day 1.

**Extension, read from the student's Disability Compensation records.**

(a) When the award carries a temporary total rating that took effect after the education benefit was established — a rating decision granting a temporary total rating, whose rating effective date is after the date the education benefit record was established — and a later decision has brought the rating down from 100 percent — a rating decision whose combined rating before the decision was 100 percent, with a rating effective date after the temporary total rating's — and the award is neither paid for individual unemployability nor rated 100 percent today: the extension is the days from the temporary total rating's effective date to the effective date of the decision that ended it. Where several such decisions are on file, the latest of each kind is read.

(b) When the award is paid for individual unemployability, or is rated 100 percent today (Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating)): the extension is the days from the award's current effective date — the effective date of the combined rating now in effect — to today.

(c) Otherwise there is no extension.

The days in (a) and (b) are the difference between the two dates, the first date not counted.

| Compensation award today | Ended temporary total period after the education benefit was established | Extension |
|---|---|---|
| Individual unemployability or 100 percent | Any | Award's current effective date to today |
| Neither | Yes | Temporary total effective date to the ending decision's effective date |
| Neither | No | None |

**Worked cases (hypothetical dates).**
- Under (a): education benefit established in 2018; temporary total rating effective February 1, 2025; a decision reducing the rating from 100 percent effective May 2, 2025; award now rated 60 percent. Extension: 90 days. For March 2026 with a delimiting date of March 5, 2026, the delimiting date moves 90 days later, past the thirtieth day, so the delimiting cut-off is day 30.
- Under (b): award paid for individual unemployability, its current effective date 200 days before today. Extension: 200 days.
- Under (c): award rated 40 percent, no temporary total rating on file. Extension: none.
